description: Inside-Out Org Chart for HR Analytics by Office Solution The Inside-Out Org Chart is a radial visualization that provides a holistic view of an organization's hierarchical structure. Designed specifically for HR analytics, this chart displays Divisions, Sub-Divisions, and Employees in a circular layout, allowing users to analyze organizational depth, employee distribution, and reporting lines efficiently. Key Components: Radial Layout: Represents the organization structure from the inside out—starting with Divisions at the center, then Sub-Divisions, and finally Employees on the outermost ring. Nodes: Each node represents a level in the organization. The size and spacing of the nodes are proportional to the number of elements within that level. Lines/Links: Curved paths connect each node to its parent, clearly depicting hierarchical relationships. Central Logo: A customizable logo is placed in the center for brand identity or focus. Tooltips: Hovering over any node displays detailed information such as name, title, division, and other relevant metadata. Basic Features: Interactive Zoom & Pan: Allows users to explore dense organizational structures with ease. Dynamic Sizing: Automatically adjusts to screen size or Power BI visual container.
